scenario: A neuro lane bridge should start from one referral ticket and only close after the requirement, prior referral, coordinator note, and status check still point to the fresh neurology referral lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the neurology routing bridge for case MED-1512. Start from referral ticket RFT-1512 and the coordinator note for that case, then only take the approved close step if the routing trail still lines up.

medical_referral_case_tickets.body_text: Referral ticket RFT-1512: close neuro_bridge_hold only after coordinator note AGN-1512, requirement note RQN-1512, previous referral note PRN-1512, and provider message PM-1512 still line up for case MED-1512.

medical_referral_agent_notes.body_text: Coordinator note AGN-1512: use provider directory entry PDR-1512 when the routing bridge is cleared; do not book directly from this hold.

medical_referral_requirement_notes.body_text: Requirement note RQN-1512: if no active neurology referral remains for MED-1512, the approved close lane is to submit a fresh neurology referral.

medical_previous_referral_notes.body_text: Previous referral note PRN-1512: the prior neurology routing item expired when the outside intake lane closed last week.

medical_provider_messages.body_text: Provider message PM-1512: once the routing bridge confirms there is no active neurology referral left, clear the hold by submitting the neurology referral rather than opening a booking lane.

medical_referral_notes.body_text: Referral note for MED-1512: the current referral lane still points to the approved close step after the evidence chain is rechecked.
